faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NEIGRIHMS Junior Resident Doctor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 18th August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident Doctor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 24 vacancies for the Junior Resident Doctor position announced by NEIGRIHMS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS or equivalent degree as per the IMC Act 1956, have completed a compulsory rotating internship, and be registered with a Central or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident Doctor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident Doctor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 56,100 per month, which is at Level 10 of the Pay Matrix, plus NPA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for NEIGRIHMS Junior Resident Doctor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through email. Candidates need to send their application and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve application screening, followed by an interview, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NEIGRIHMS located?
faq.answer: NEIGRIHMS is located in Shillong, Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
